text: City officials announced on Tuesday that the downtown library will reopen next month after a year of renovations. The project added two reading rooms, a children's area, and new climate control systems for the archive collection.

The regional transit authority said it will extend the north line by three stations next year, connecting the airport district with the university campus. Construction is expected to begin in early spring.

Local farmers reported an early harvest this season after unusually warm weather in April. Orchard owners said the apple crop is about ten percent larger than last year, though prices remain steady at market.

The museum's new exhibition on maritime trade opens Friday and runs through the summer. Curators gathered more than two hundred artifacts, including maps, ship logs, and coins recovered from harbor excavations.

A community garden project converted a vacant lot on Cedar Street into forty planting beds. Volunteers meet every Saturday morning, and the first harvest will be shared with the neighborhood food pantry.

The city council approved funding for repairs to the old stone bridge over the mill river. Engineers say the work will take about six months and the bridge will remain open to pedestrians during construction.
